biotools.summary:
A newly available database of an important family of phytophagous mites.

The Tenuipalpidae is one of the most important families of phytophagous mites. Several tenuipalpids species are considered pests in many crops around the world. They also are known as flat mites and false spider mites.
biotools.name: Tenuipalpidae

metadata.abstract: © 2020 Magnolia Press.This paper announces a database on the taxonomy, distribution and host plants of mites of the family Tenuipalpidae Berlese (Acari: Tetranychoidea), available online at https://www.tenuipalpidae.ibilce.unesp.br/. In the Tenuipalpidae Database the recorded world distribution and range of host plants are provided for each tenuipalpid species, including synonyms, with a list of all relevant publications.
metadata.title: A newly available database of an important family of phytophagous mites: Tenuipalpidae Database
